posts.linkedin:
Freelancers and agencies lose hours each morning copying contact details from Google Maps instead of writing pitches.

When you look for local clients you often open Google Places, copy a phone number, glance at a website, and paste the information into a spreadsheet. You repeat this for every prospect. By lunchtime the list is half‑finished and no outreach has begun. A café, a gym, or a clinic all appear the same way in search results, and gathering them one by one is slow.

I offer a ready‑made daily lead sheet for anyone selling a service to local businesses. It is not a website, an ad campaign, or a sales funnel. It is an Excel file that contains businesses found through Google Places, their contact details, review counts, and a short note taken from their website. The sheet also flags newly opened businesses that appear in Google Places.

The process is simple. First you tell me what service you provide and the types of local businesses you want to target. I then pull the relevant data from Google Places, visit each website briefly, and add a concise comment about the business. When the sheet is ready you review it and request any changes. You pay only after you approve the work, so no money moves until you are satisfied.

With a completed sheet your morning starts with a list of qualified leads instead of a search bar. You can spend the time writing personalized pitches and sending messages rather than collecting names and numbers. The sheet makes the early part of outreach easier, but it does not write your pitch for you and it does not guarantee any specific result.

The lead sheet works for any service—marketing, accounting, coaching, or any other offering—to any local business across India. It is a starting point, not a complete sales system, and it leaves the conversation and relationship building entirely in your hands.

If you think this could fit your workflow, feel free to reach out. DM LEADS
